# Nepali holiday calendar

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/nepali-holidays/

Browse a sourced Nepali holiday list with dates, scope and calendar export. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Filter the bundled 2083 holiday entries by month and inspect whether a holiday applies nationally or to a group.

## Limits and checks

Holiday scope and special announcements matter. The bundled calendar identifies its year and source and does not assume every observance is a nationwide closure.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.

## Method and sources

- [Nepal Ministry of Home Affairs — public holidays BS 2083](https://moha.gov.np/page/government-and-public-holidays-in-2083)
